messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "15 to 30 minutes"
set: ["15 to 30 minutes", "15 mg, 30 mg", "use 2 inhalations 15 to 30 minutes before you exercise to prevent exercise-induced bronchospasm", "take 30 minutes after dinner", "at least 30 to 60 minutes before breakfast", "use the mixture within 15 minutes", "administer 15 minutes before eating breakfast", "first dose infused over 15 minutes", "first parenteral dose infused over 15 minutes", "exercising at least 30 minutes most days", "take at least 30 minutes after aspirin", "given as a bolus infusion over 15 minutes", "6 to 15 hours", "take on empty stomach at least 30 to 60 minutes before breakfast", "taken 30 minutes before the start of single-day HEC", "dose taken 30 minutes before start of single-day HEC"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
